newsitem.title: GERMANY: German construction sector crisis structural - Ifo.
newsitem.headline: German construction sector crisis structural - Ifo.

text.p: The west German construction industry, already mired in a painful downturn, is unlikely to see a significant rebound before 2006, a key economic institute said in a report on Monday.
"The west German construction sector is not only going through a weak economic phase, but is stuck in a structural crisis," the Ifo Institute for Economic Research said.

Ifo predicted only moderate growth over the next nine years. It said moderate household income growth, uncertain tax conditions and high real estate prices would counteract impulses from European monetary union, increasing numbers of single-parent households and nominal rent increases.
Commercial construction was likely to follow a flat growth rate against inflation, while residential construction would rise modestly. Public sector building would fall, it predicted.
